mapper.select: SELECT cf.id, cf.api_id, cf.flow_name, cf.description, cf.file_content, cf.img, cf.system_id, cf.module_id, cf.create_time, cf.create_by, cf.update_time, cf.update_by, cf.deleted, sb.system_name systemName, sbm.module_name moduleName FROM chor_flow cf LEFT JOIN sys_bussys sb ON cf.system_id = sb.system_code LEFT JOIN sys_bussys_module sbm ON cf.module_id = sbm.module_code ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
